deploy-bot: :warning: auto-fallback triggered — canary p95 latency 2.7s (>2.5s) + embeddings error rate up 1.4% over 5m. Suggested action: HOLD traffic, consider manual rollback to v2.3.1. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/fallbacks#canary

alice: ack. watching dashboards. curious if KV-cache warmup will resolve in next 10m? last deploy touched kernel flags.

ben: errors are spikey and concentrated on /v1/embeddings, not KV cache. I'm +1 for manual rollback now. if we wait 10m we risk customer impact.

carol: I have manual rollback authority for this window. @dave-oncall can you prep execution? confirm scope (canary-only) and post-rollback customer note.

dave-oncall: oncall here. I'll run. command from runbook (will run with dry-run check first):
```
./infra/deployctl rollback --svc inference-gateway --to v2.3.1 --scope canary --drain-seconds 60 --confirm
```
I'll snapshot current routing and annotate the release notes.

alice: fine with that. please include a quick grep of logs for any migration errors before shifting traffic: `kubectl logs -lapp=inference -n prod --since=10m | grep migration`

ben: tagging potential customer impact: embeddings customers in eu-west may see degraded similarity scores. draft cust blurb in #customer-notify once rollback completes.

carol: executing manual rollback now. I will also pin v2.3.1 for 1h to avoid autopilot re-roll. pin command: `./infra/deployctl pin --svc inference-gateway --version v2.3.1 --ttl 1h`

ops-bot: snapshot created: snap-6854321090. traffic-snapshot://snap-6854321090

dave-oncall: dry-run OK. executing real rollback...

ops-bot: deployctl: initiating rollback -> target v2.3.1 (canary). draining 60s.

ops-bot: traffic shifted: canary -> v2.3.1. roll-forward disabled. pin applied.
notes: thread contains runbook links, commands, and a short customer comms plan
